description:
Schedule a finished run to post at scheduled_at (ISO-8601).
Shows in the customer's local timezone. platforms: x, instagram,
tiktok, linkedin, youtube, or everything. Posts fire sequentially.
Requires Allow posting. Prefer this over post_run when the user
names a time. On create_campaign you can pass scheduled_at instead.

captions.description: Optional caption override per platform, e.g. {"x": "...", "linkedin": "..."}.

platforms.description: Where to post: any of x, instagram, tiktok, linkedin, youtube, or ["everything"] for every connected channel.

run_id.description: The run id returned by create_campaign, render_asset, or list_runs.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 time to post, e.g. 2026-09-12T09:00:00. Interpreted in the given timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for scheduled_at, e.g. Africa/Lagos or America/New_York.

name: schedule_post
